views.title: Footing course and ground floor
views.desc: One course of 8in Standard on the footing in each floor zone (lower zone 124.40: kitchen / dining / snug; upper zone 125.00: all other rooms) and the block and beam ground floor bearing on it, with insulation and screed (indicative).

views.title: Ground floor ICF walls and partitions
views.desc: The 6in XR35 ground-floor walls to the underside of the wall plate (127.741), with the structural glazing, sliding doors, windows and doors (alu-clad, indicative) openings, and the internal blockwork and stud partitions (indicative).

views.title: Gables, chimney stack and vault upstands
views.desc: The west and south-east gables raked to the 35 degree roof, the chimney stack carried up to 130.941 over the flue (the part inside the gable on a steel frame - engineer), and the north-east walls that sit back from the eaves line raised to the underside of the vaulted roof.

views.title: Vaulted roof, oak trusses and steels
views.desc: The vaulted roof structure (C24 rafters @ 400 on steel ridges, hips, valley and purlins), the arched oak trusses A1-A3 and the posts, all indicative - engineer / oak frame supplier to design. Rafters trimmed round the chimney stack.
